findings.body: The only real-database proof for the combined statement is conditionally skipped unless `WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1`. The supplied close run shows this exact test as `# SKIP`, and no successful warehouse-proof run is provided. Consequently the normal required suite never executes the assertions that distinguish the new multi-plant SQL from the old one. Run this test against the mandated throwaway Postgres as part of the task's recorded verification.

findings.body: The combined-row assertion derives its expected value from `plantRows`, which is produced by the same builder and query logic. If a regression filtered all CHIR Actuals out, CHIR would be zero-filled, the combined result would equal DUB, and these assertions plus the explicitly zero CHIR example would still pass. This does not prove the required shared leaf receives both plants' mapped triples without loss or double counting. Add an independent one-plant CHIR oracle and assert a known nonzero shared leaf and total against DUB + CHIR.

findings.body: The new multi-plant resolver currently has no production caller. The unchanged statement path at `backend/src/chat/chat.service.ts:1463-1475` still requires exactly one scoped plant and returns a scope refusal for a multi-plant reader, then calls singleton `resolver.resolve` at line 1489. Thus the user-facing combined statement and its end-to-end proof remain deferred to the Tasks table's MP-ASK-STATEMENT task.

findings.body: This patch correctly places budget rows on the owner plant, but it stops at the projection layer. It does not yet assemble per-row `budgetStates`, restrict comparisons before limits/totals/drill preparation, return `leftOut` or the no-budget informational answer, or render accessible dash cells. The Tasks table assigns those remaining Done-when 5 behaviors and their user-facing tests to MP-ASK-BUDGET and MP-ASK-UI-RESULTS.
